# Coverage map

This page maps every crate feature, agent-protocol method, CLI command and content format to the
page that documents it. It is the single source of truth for `cargo xtask book-check`: the agent
method table below must cover `regia_agent::schema::METHODS` exactly, and each mapped page must
exist and mention its method. `book-check` also runs `cargo xtask agent-coverage`: every method
the dispatcher registers has a schema entry, a bundled `agent.guide` topic that names it, a row
in that table, a mention on the mapped page, and a test that calls it.

| Rust method (host simulation) | Stats surface | Agent guide |
|---|---|---|
| `regia_detsim::spatial::DetSpatial::stats` (host-owned; no new protocol method) | `SpatialStats`: builds, queries, candidates, selected hits, refiles and wild rows; future `sim.tick_profile` input | [Range and nearest queries](agents/det-ids-broadphase.md#range-and-nearest-queries) |
| `regia_detsim::spatial::DetSpatial::{along_segment, first_along_segment, within_sector, within_box, build_from}` (host-owned; no new protocol method; ADR-8478) | `SpatialStats`: segment queries, shape queries, cells walked; error `spatial_slot` from `build_from` | [Segment and shape queries](agents/det-ids-broadphase.md#segment-and-shape-queries) |
| `regia_detsim::ai::TeamRosters::stats`, `regia_detsim::ai::SlotIndex::stats` (host-owned; no new protocol method; ADR-8484) | `RosterStats`: builds, rows read, members, teams; `SlotIndexStats`: builds, hits, scan fallbacks; error code `roster_team_out_of_range`; future `sim.tick_profile` input. `cargo test -p regia_detsim --test ai_core` (`rosters_match_a_linear_scan_every_tick`, `rosters_read_each_row_once_per_tick_instead_of_once_per_unit`) | [Deterministic AI core](agents/det-ai-core.md) |
| `regia_detsim::ai::TargetSelector::report` (host-owned; no new protocol method; ADR-8517) | `TargetPickReport` (serde): tick, units, picks, scores evaluated, candidates seen, forced re-picks, kept targets; error codes `ai_rules_unknown_version`, `ai_rules_version_too_old`, `ai_rules_peer_too_old`, `ai_rules_bad_rings`, `ai_rules_bad_max_candidates`, `ai_rules_bad_repick_ticks`; future `sim.ai_rows` (ai-nav-05) and `sim.tick_profile` input. `cargo test -p regia_detsim --test ai_targets` (`exhaustive_rule_equals_a_brute_force_scan`, `ringed_rule_scores_at_most_n_k_over_r_per_tick`) | [Deterministic AI core](agents/det-ai-core.md#target-selection) |
| `regia_detsim::ai::PerceptionIndex::stats` (host-owned; no new protocol method; ADR-8518) | `PerceptionIndexStats`: refreshes, linear fallbacks, queries, candidates, LOS calls, scan pairs (the all-pairs reads saved); future `sim.tick_profile` input. `cargo test -p regia_detsim --test ai_perception_index` (`indexed_refresh_equals_the_linear_refresh_every_tick`, `refresh_work_is_bounded_by_density`, `views_borrow_and_allocate_nothing_after_warmup`) | [Deterministic perception and influence](agents/det-ai-perception.md) |
| `regia_detsim::scale_soak::ai::{AiSoakScenario, AiSoakConfig, AiSoakRunner, AiSoakMeasurement, AI_SOAK_SYSTEMS}` (host-owned; no new protocol method; ADR-8561) | AI-on soak: ten profiled systems whose `ProfileReport` a host publishes through `sim.tick_profile` (one row per system); `regia-ai-soak` JSON from `scale_soak --ai`; codes `invalid_ai_soak_teams`, `invalid_ai_soak_counts`, `invalid_ai_soak_geometry`, `invalid_ai_soak_queries`, `invalid_ai_soak_shots`, `invalid_ai_soak_combat`, `invalid_ai_soak_measurement`, `oracle_mismatch` | [Deterministic scale soak](agents/det-scale-soak.md) |
| `regia_detsim::ai::AiCore::due_units`, `AiCore::cadence_report`, `AiCore::queued` (host-owned; no new protocol method; ADR-8560) | `CadenceReport` (serde) per channel: channel, tick, due, ran, carried, max wait; `QueuedUnit` rows; error codes `ai_cadence_empty_name`, `ai_cadence_duplicate_name`, `ai_cadence_builtin_channels`, `ai_cadence_too_many_channels`, `ai_cadence_too_many_tiers`, `ai_cadence_unknown_channel`; future `sim.ai_rows` (ai-nav-05) input. `cargo test -p regia_detsim --test ai_cadence` (`hashed_phase_spreads_clustered_ids`, `cap_carries_over_in_wait_then_id_order`, `no_unit_waits_longer_than_the_bound`, `tier_change_keeps_the_phase_rule`, `channels_are_independent`, `cadence_settings_round_trip_and_validate`), `cargo test -p regia_detsim --test ai_core default_cadence_is_bit_identical` | [Deterministic AI core](agents/det-ai-core.md#cadence-channels-tiers-and-caps) |
| `regia_detsim::ai::UtilityCatalogue` (`from_ron_str`, `do27_preset`, `explain`, `score_options_idx`, `ArgMaxIdx`; host-owned; no new protocol method; ADR-8609) | `.detutility.ron` (format `ai-det-utility` v1, fuzz target `ai.det_utility`); `OptionExplain` (serde): option and input names, raw inputs, curve values; error codes `det_utility_parse`, `det_utility_newer_version`, `det_utility_unsupported_version`, `det_utility_unknown_input`, `det_utility_duplicate_name`, `det_utility_bad_name`, `det_utility_non_finite`, `det_utility_over_cap`; future `sim.ai_explain` (ai-nav-05) input. `cargo test -p regia_detsim --test ai_catalogue` (`preset_scores_equal_the_enum_scores_bit_for_bit`, `a_game_adds_an_option_and_an_input`, `bad_catalogues_are_refused_with_named_errors`, `catalogue_ron_round_trips`, `newer_version_is_refused`), `cargo test -p regia_detsim --test ai_core pinned_decisions_hold_through_the_catalogue_index_path` | [Deterministic AI core](agents/det-ai-core.md#your-own-catalogue) |
| `regia_detsim::broadphase::{BroadphaseConfig::{world_bounds, large_radius}, BroadphaseStats::{outliers, large}}`, `regia_detsim::spatial::SpatialStats::{outlier_rows, large_rows}` (host-owned; no new protocol method; ADR-8837) | Outliers and large bodies kept off the grid, counted per pass (`DetBroadphase::stats`) and as gauges (`DetSpatial::stats`); no error codes. `cargo test -p regia_detsim --test det_crowd` (`one_parked_body_does_not_collapse_the_grid`, `one_large_body_does_not_widen_every_gather`, `random_bounds_outliers_and_radius_mixes_match_the_n2_loop`); `cargo test -p regia_detsim --test spatial_oracle` (`a_parked_row_does_not_collapse_the_query_grid`, `a_large_row_does_not_widen_every_query`) | [Outliers and large bodies](agents/det-ids-broadphase.md#outliers-and-large-bodies) |

Runtime gameplay (spec 14 § A3/A4/B3/B6 agent surface): `scene.spawn_prefab`, `level.open`,
`level.unload`, `rules.get`, `timers.list` and `tweens.list` are built-in methods documented on
the [runtime gameplay](agents/runtime-gameplay.md) page.

Editor-side methods (`editor.*`) are registered by `regia_editor::agent_ext`, not the runtime
schema table, and are documented on the [editor](agents/editor.md) agent page; the animation
editor's `editor.anim_*` and `editor.capture_panel` on the [animation editor](agents/animation-editor.md) page;
the kit viewer's `editor.open_kit` on the [open kit](agents/open-kit.md) page (a table row here would fail
`agent-coverage`, which accepts only runtime-dispatched methods).
The Outliner's hierarchy edits (`editor.hierarchy`, `editor.reparent`, `editor.group`, `editor.duplicate`,
`editor.delete`, `editor.select_hierarchy`) are documented on the [hierarchy](agents/hierarchy.md) page.

The Bake panel's `editor.bake_get`, `editor.bake_set`, `editor.bake_start` and `editor.bake_cancel` are
documented on the [baking from the editor](agents/baked-gi-editor.md) page.

`steam.status` is registered by the Steam plugin (`regia_steam`) on the world's `AgentExtension`,
not the runtime schema table, and is documented on the [steam](agents/steam.md) agent page.
`steam.input` and `steam.input_manifest` are registered the same way and documented on the same page.
`steam.deck` is registered the same way and documented on the same page.
`steam.glyphs`, `steam.deck_perf` and `steam.set_deck_preset` (ADR-526) are registered the same way and
documented on the same page.
`steam.layout` (ADR-1332) is registered the same way and documented on the same page.

The editor's undo history and structural edits (`editor.history`, `editor.spawn`, `editor.delete`,
`editor.reparent`, `editor.duplicate`, `editor.add_component`, `editor.remove_component`) are registered by
`regia_editor::undo_agent` and documented on the [undo and redo](agents/undo-redo.md) agent page.

More editor-side methods, documented on their own pages for the same reason: `editor.bake_gi`,
`editor.bake_status` and `editor.bake_gi_cancel` on [editor bake](agents/editor-bake.md);
`editor.budget` on [editor budget](agents/editor-budget.md); `editor.content_index` on
[editor content index](agents/editor-content-index.md); `editor.reparent` on
[editor hierarchy](agents/editor-hierarchy.md); `editor.fracture_preview` (ADR-1567) and the Fracture
panel's `editor.fracture_panel_get`, `editor.fracture_panel_set`, `editor.fracture_panel_run`,
`editor.fracture_panel_save` and `editor.fracture_panel_apply_meta` (ADR-1967), and its tools
`editor.fracture_test_hit`, `editor.fracture_test_reset`, `editor.fracture_bonds` and
`editor.fracture_place` (ADR-9750) on [pre-fractured destruction](agents/fracture.md).

`editor.asset_thumbnails` (the Content Browser's thumbnail cache), `editor.content_view` (list or grid) and the
search query syntax shared by `editor.content_index` and `editor.list_assets` are documented on
[editor asset browser](agents/editor-asset-browser.md).

The `LightSourceSize` component has no method of its own: agents add it with `scene.add_component` and edit
`radius_m` with `editor.set_property`, as documented on the [light source size](agents/light-source-size.md) page.

`physics.cloth_stats` is registered on the world's `AgentExtension` by `regia_agent::cloth::install_cloth_methods`
(for apps with `regia_physics::cloth::ClothPlugin`), not the runtime schema table, and is documented on the
[cloth](agents/cloth.md) agent page.
The same call registers `physics.cloth_inspect`, `physics.cloth_set_params`, `physics.cloth_pin`,
`physics.cloth_unpin`, `physics.cloth_wind`, `physics.cloth_step` and `physics.cloth_reset` (spec 55, ADR-1672),
documented on the [cloth](agents/cloth.md) page; soft bodies are their targets too
([soft bodies](agents/soft-bodies.md)).
[cloth](agents/cloth.md) agent page. `AgentPlugin` installs it in every app with the agent (ADR-1809), so it has a
row in the table above.
`editor.atlas_generate` (the lightmap UV atlas generator, ADR-1483) is registered by `regia_editor::atlas_agent`
and documented on the [lightmap UV atlas](agents/atlas.md) page.
`editor.fbx_inspect` (the FBX importer's report, ADR-1602) and `editor.obj_inspect` (the OBJ reader's report) are
registered by `regia_editor::fbx_agent` and documented on the [FBX import](agents/fbx-import.md) page.
`editor.bvh_inspect` (the BVH motion-capture importer's report, ADR-2532) is registered by `regia_editor::bvh_agent` and
documented on the [BVH import](agents/bvh-import.md) page; `.bvh` sources cook with importer `bvh`.
`editor.ply_inspect`, `editor.stl_inspect` and `editor.psd_inspect` (the PLY and STL mesh importers' and the PSD image importer's reports,
ADR-3244) are registered by `regia_editor::mesh_image_agent` and documented on the [PLY, STL and PSD import](agents/mesh-image-import.md)
page; `.ply` and `.stl` sources cook with importers `ply` and `stl` (converted glTF), `.psd` with importer `psd` (a texture).
`editor.mode2d_get`, `editor.mode2d_set`, `editor.tile_stroke` and `editor.tilemap_save` (the editor's 2D mode,
`editor.mode2d_get`, `editor.mode2d_set`, `editor.tile_stroke`, `editor.tile_stamp` and `editor.tilemap_save` (the editor's 2D mode,
ADR-1889) are registered by `regia_editor::mode2d` and documented on the [editor 2D mode](agents/editor-2d.md) page.

`render.breadcrumbs`, `render.fault_inject` (only with the `test-hooks` feature), `telemetry.mark`, `telemetry.range_open`,
`telemetry.range_close`, `telemetry.trace` (ADR-1671) and `telemetry.screenshot_mark` (ADR-2307) are registered on the
world's `AgentExtension` by `regia_agent::breadcrumbs::install_breadcrumb_methods` and
`regia_agent::trace::install_trace_methods`, not the runtime schema table, and are documented on the
[GPU breadcrumbs and trace markers](agents/gpu-breadcrumbs-and-trace.md) page. Since ADR-2307 `AgentPlugin` installs all
of them except `render.fault_inject` in every app with the agent, so they have rows in the table above;
`render.fault_inject` stays with test hosts that call `install_breadcrumb_methods`.

Editor tools (ADR-1523): `editor.tool_list`, `editor.tool_status`, `editor.tool_methods`, `editor.tool_call`,
`editor.tool_launch`, `editor.tool_stop`, `editor.tool_click`, `editor.tool_panel` and the tool-side
`editor.tool_poll`, `editor.tool_reply`, `editor.tool_progress` and `editor.tool_set_view` are registered by
`regia_editor::tools::agent` and documented on the [editor tools](agents/editor-tools.md) page.

`physics.cloth_edit_map` (vertex-map edits of a cloth asset, spec 55 § 3.4, ADR-2083) is registered by the same
`install_cloth_methods` call and documented on the [cloth](agents/cloth.md#physicscloth_edit_map) page; with the
`regia_framework::cloth` glue every `physics.cloth_*` method also takes `{ entity }` of a `ClothSim` or `SoftSim`.
Levels store `ClothSimSource` and `SoftSimSource`; `regia cook` cooks `.cloth.ron` and `.soft.ron` (the [Cloth and
ropes](user-guide/cloth.md) guide).

Spec 51 and 53 (ADR-1649) register their methods on the world's `AgentExtension`, not the runtime schema table
(`AgentPlugin` installs them in every app with the agent, ADR-1809, so they have rows in the table above):
`curves.list`, `curves.describe`, `curves.get`, `curves.sample`, `curves.set_key`, `curves.remove_key`,
`curves.set_curve`, `curves.delete`, `curves.validate`, `curves.export` and `curves.import` by
`regia_agent::curve_tables::install_curve_table_methods`, documented on the [curve tables](agents/curve-tables.md)
page; `chooser.list`, `chooser.describe`, `chooser.get`, `chooser.set_cell`, `chooser.set_row`, `chooser.remove_row`,
`chooser.set_column`, `chooser.remove_column`, `chooser.set_options`, `chooser.validate`, `chooser.evaluate`,
`chooser.evaluate_binding`, `chooser.trace` and `chooser.export` by `regia_agent::choosers::install_chooser_methods`,
documented on the [choosers](agents/choosers.md) page; `abilities.list`, `abilities.inspect`, `abilities.check`,
`abilities.grant`, `abilities.revoke`, `abilities.activate`, `abilities.charge`, `abilities.end`, `abilities.cancel`,
`abilities.signal`, `abilities.apply_effect`, `abilities.remove_effect`, `abilities.set_base`,
`abilities.add_attributes`, `abilities.cues`, `abilities.validate`, `abilities.stats` and `abilities.state_hash` by
`regia_agent::abilities::install_ability_methods`, documented on the [abilities](agents/abilities.md) page.

The procedural graph editor's `editor.procgen_open`, `editor.procgen_new`, `editor.procgen_state`,
`editor.procgen_reload`, `editor.procgen_starters`, `editor.procgen_param`, `editor.procgen_preview`, `editor.procgen_seed`, `editor.procgen_palette`,
`editor.procgen_pin`, `editor.procgen_select`, `editor.procgen_visualize`,
`editor.procgen_table`, `editor.procgen_isolate`, `editor.procgen_collapse`, `editor.procgen_expand`,
`editor.procgen_capture`, `editor.procgen_tool`, `editor.procgen_tool_cancel`, `editor.procgen_view_set` (spec 67, ADR-1675) and
`editor.plant_preview` (spec 68 § 8, ADR-7215) are registered by
`regia_editor::procgen::agent` and documented on the [procedural graph editor](agents/procgen-editor.md) page.

The Content Chunks panel's `editor.content_chunks_state`, `editor.content_chunks_why`, `editor.content_chunks_size_map`,
`editor.content_chunks_references` and `editor.content_chunks_set_rule` (spec 40 § 6, ADR-1876) are registered by
`regia_editor::chunks_panel` and documented on the [Content Chunks panel](agents/content-chunks-panel.md) page.

`lua.list`, `lua.run`, `lua.globals`, `lua.errors`, `lua.restart`, `lua.reload`, `lua.state`, `lua.watch` and
`lua.entity_cap` are registered by the Lua mods plugin
(`regia_script_lua::LuaModsPlugin`, the `lua` feature, ADR-1751) on the world's `AgentExtension`, not the runtime
schema table, and are documented on the [Lua mods](agents/lua-mods.md) page.

`lua.components`, `lua.props.get`, `lua.props.set` and `lua.props.list` (ADR-3356, script components) are
registered by the same plugin on the world's `AgentExtension` and are documented on the
[Lua script components](agents/lua-component-props.md) page.

The UI designer (ADR-1811): `editor.ui_designer_open`, `editor.ui_designer_state`, `editor.ui_designer_edit`,
`editor.ui_designer_lint`, `editor.ui_designer_preview`, `editor.ui_designer_render` and `editor.ui_designer_save`
(with `editor.ui_designer_images` for the picture picker) are registered by
`regia_editor::ui_designer_agent` and documented on the [UI designer](agents/ui-designer.md) page, with the
view-model binding fields of `.ui.ron` v3 and the collection templates and converters of v6 (ADR-2489:
`repeat`, `converter`, `ui.collection_state`, saves that keep comments, the `ui-repeat` fuzz target).

The gameplay data panels (ADR-2031): the Tables panel's `editor.tables_panel_open`, `editor.tables_panel_get`,
`editor.tables_panel_curve_edit`, `editor.tables_panel_chooser_edit`, `editor.tables_panel_set_context`,
`editor.tables_panel_undo` and `editor.tables_panel_save` (spec 51 § 6) with `editor.tables_panel_data_edit` (the Data tab
of typed data tables, ADR-2132); the Abilities inspector's
`editor.abilities_panel_get`, `editor.abilities_panel_select`, `editor.abilities_panel_call` and
`editor.abilities_panel_asset` (spec 53 § 6); the
Montage timeline's `editor.montage_panel_open`, `editor.montage_panel_get`, `editor.montage_panel_edit`,
`editor.montage_panel_preview` and `editor.montage_panel_select` (spec 34 M10); and the Ragdoll editor's
`editor.ragdoll_panel_open`, `editor.ragdoll_panel_get`, `editor.ragdoll_panel_edit`, `editor.ragdoll_panel_set_rig`
and `editor.ragdoll_panel_save` are registered by `regia_editor::tables_panel`, `abilities_panel`, `montage_panel` and
`ragdoll_panel` and documented on the [editor gameplay data panels](agents/editor-data-panels.md) page.

The material graph editor's `editor.matgraph_open`, `editor.matgraph_state`, `editor.matgraph_edit`,
`editor.matgraph_compile`, `editor.matgraph_preview` and `editor.matgraph_save` (ADR-2318) are registered by
`regia_editor::matgraph_editor::agent` and documented on the [material graph editor](agents/material-graph-editor.md) page.

Prefab variants (ADR-2323): `editor.create_prefab_variant`, `editor.prefab_variant` and `editor.set_variant_override`
are registered by `regia_editor::prefab_variant_edit` and documented on the [prefab variants](agents/prefab-variants.md) page.

## 3. CLI commands → user guide

| Command | What it does | Page |
|---|---|---|
| `regia plugin list`, `info <id>`, `check [--platform P] [--profile P]`, `enable <id> [--grant CAP] [--grant-all] [--platform P]`, `disable <id> [--platform P]`, `sync`, `build <id> [--release] [--target-dir DIR]`, `new <id> [--content]`, `tool <id> <name> -- ARGS` (all take `--project DIR`, `--json`) | The project's extensions: discovery, the resolver as a dry run (exit 1 on an error), `[extensions]` edits, the generated link list, stamped dynamic libraries, scaffolding, bounded helper runs (spec 57, ADR-1885). | [Extensions](agents/plugins.md) |
| `regia new <name> [--template blank\|first_person\|third_person\|top_down\|quick\|net_game] [--path DIR]` | Scaffold a project from a template (`net-game` is an alias of `net_game`). | [Your first project](getting-started.md), [Project structure](user-guide/project-structure.md) |
| `regia doctor [--platform …]` | Check toolchains (Rust, Vulkan, Android SDK/NDK) and print fixes. | [Installing Regia Engine](start/install.md) |
| `regia preview <asset> [--project …]` | Preview a cooked asset in a window. | [Materials](user-guide/materials.md) |
| `regia cook [--platform …] [--quality …] [--clean] [--stats]` | Cook project assets for a platform. | [Assets and the cook](fundamentals/assets.md), [Packaging](user-guide/packaging.md), [Startup asset work](agents/startup-assets.md) |
| `regia package --platform … [--format …] [--profile …] [--steam]` | Build a distributable package (APK/AAB/tar/zip). | [Packaging](user-guide/packaging.md) |
| `regia package --server --platform linux\|windows [--profile …] [--dry-run]` | Build the dedicated server: the `server` feature, the asset-kind filter, `net-manifest.ron`, `server.toml`, `bans.ron`, `README-server.txt`; Android and macOS fail with `server_platform_unsupported`, exit code 2 (spec 76 § 3, ADR-1886). | [Net dedicated server (agents)](agents/net-dedicated-server.md#building-and-packaging), [Packaging](user-guide/packaging.md#dedicated-servers) |
| `regia server [--project …] [--level …] [--port …] [--clients N] [--agent]` | The dedicated server's dev loop: from the dev cache, with headless clients on loopback and the agent protocol (spec 76 § 10, ADR-1886). | [Net dedicated server (agents)](agents/net-dedicated-server.md#building-and-packaging) |
| `regia install-android` | Package, install with adb, launch, stream logcat. | [Packaging](user-guide/packaging.md) |
| `regia steam upload --branch …` | Upload packaged Steam depots via steamcmd. | [Steam](user-guide/steam.md) |
| `regia upgrade-project [--write]` | Run content-format migrators. | [Content formats](reference/formats.md) |
| `regia agent call <method> [json] [--project …]` | Call one protocol method and print its result. | [Agent protocol](user-guide/agent-protocol.md) |
| `regia test [PROJECT] --level L [--filter G] [--tag T] [--seed N] [--param k=v] [--report FILE] [--junit FILE] [--update-expected] [--loop]` | Run the functional tests of a level headless; exit 0 passed, 1 failed, 2 aborted or undecided, 3 none ran, 4 harness failure. | [Functional tests](agents/functional-tests.md) |
| `regia test session FILE [--recover] [--keep-artifacts] [--param k=v]` | Launch the processes of a `.session.ron`, or drive the device a `Remote` build names, and decide from verdicts and logs. | [Functional tests](agents/functional-tests.md) |
| `regia mcp [--project …] [--attach]` | Run an MCP stdio server over the protocol. | [Agent protocol](user-guide/agent-protocol.md) |
| `regia-editor [--project DIR] [--game CRATE]` | The editor (separate binary, not a `regia` subcommand). | [Editor](user-guide/editor.md) |
| `regia bake-gi <scene> [--dry-run] [--out …]` | Bake a GI probe volume (`.fgiv`) from a built-in or a `.bake.ron`; `--dry-run` prints the layout without tracing. | [Baking GI from meshes](agents/baked-gi-bake.md) |
| `pak_migrate <old.fpak> <new.fpak> [--raw]` | Convert an existing desktop pak to GPU-ready mesh entries without a re-cook. | [Assets (agents)](agents/assets.md) |
| `cargo xtask windows-pass [--read <summary.json>]` | Windows test subset, pipeline compile times and start-and-quit runs; `--read` prints the verdict. | [Windows](user-guide/windows.md) |
| `regia bake-gi <scene> --check-volume <volume.fgiv>` | Compare a baked volume with its description (no GPU) and fail with `bake_volume_stale` and the reasons when a mesh, interior, light or setting changed. | [Baking GI from meshes](agents/baked-gi-bake.md) |
| `sky_lab [--frames N] [--size WxH] [--from P] [--to P] [--start-hour H] [--end-hour H] [--out DIR] [--every N] [--list]` | Sample binary: render a day cycle with a weather change headless; writes PNG frames and `report.json`. | [Sky Lab (user guide)](user-guide/sky-lab.md), [Sky Lab (agent guide)](agents/sky-lab.md) |
| `regia bake-gi --from-scene <level> [--from-static-meshes …] [--check \| --bake \| --write-level]` | Export a level (and a DO27 bundle) to its `.bake.ron`; `--check` exits 2 when it is stale. | [Exporting a map's bake input](agents/baked-gi-export.md) |
| `regia bake-gi … --cpu` | Bake on the CPU probe tracer instead of the GPU (no GPU needed; checks and small scenes). | [Checking a bake end to end](agents/baked-gi-bake-check.md) |
| `regia bake-gi --sample <volume.fgiv> --at x,y,z [--normal x,y,z]` | Print the irradiance the runtime lights each point with (lux per component, coverage). | [Checking a bake end to end](agents/baked-gi-bake-check.md) |
| `cargo xtask bake-check [--gpu]` | Baked light end to end on the fixture project: export, bake, level, check, sample, runtime install. | [Checking a bake end to end](agents/baked-gi-bake-check.md) |
| `regia bake-gi <scene> --check-volume <volume.fgiv>` | Compare a baked volume with its description (no GPU) and fail with `bake_volume_stale` and the reasons when a mesh, interior, light or setting changed. | [Baking GI from meshes](agents/baked-gi-bake.md) |
| `regia bake-gi <scene> --incremental <state> [--plan-incremental] [--influence m] [--tile-columns n]` | Rebake only the bricks and terrain tiles near what changed since the last bake (state file); `--plan-incremental` prints what would be traced and why without tracing. | [Incremental GI bakes](agents/baked-gi-incremental.md) |

## 4. Content formats → user guide

| Format | Extension | What it stores | Page |
|---|---|---|---|
| Level | `.level.ron` | A saved scene (entities + components). | [Scenes](user-guide/scenes.md) |
| Prefab | `.prefab.ron` | A reusable entity subtree with overrides. | [Scenes](user-guide/scenes.md) |
| Material | `.material.ron` | Shader + parameters. | [Materials](user-guide/materials.md) |
| Material graph / instance | `.matgraph.ron` / `.matinst.ron` | Node graph compiled to the surface function; instance overrides. | [Material graphs](systems/material-graph.md) |
| Meta | `.meta` | Provenance and import settings sidecar. | [Assets and the cook](fundamentals/assets.md) |
| UI | `.ui.ron` | Runtime UI layout and widgets. | [UI](user-guide/ui.md) |
| UI theme | `.theme.ron` | Design tokens, `extends` chain, widget types and variations. | [UI themes](agents/ui-theme.md), editing in the editor: [Theme panel](agents/ui-theme-panel.md) |
| UI settings (`uisettings`) | `.uisettings.ron` (v1) | The project's UI settings at `assets/ui/project.uisettings.ron`: DPI curve, group layer budget. | [UI group layers](agents/ui-group-layers.md) |
| Anim graph | `.animgraph.ron` | State machines, blend spaces, layers. | [Animation](user-guide/animation.md) |
| Anim authoring sidecar | `.animedit.ron` | Editor-authored notifies, curves, property tracks, sockets, IK chains for an imported rig. | [Animation](user-guide/animation.md) |
| Spring bones | `.spring.ron` | Hair, tail and cloth-strip chains with stiffness, damping, gravity and body colliders. | [Spring bones](agents/spring-bones.md) |
| Audio cue / patch | RON | Event cues and parametric patches. | [Audio](user-guide/audio.md) |
| Loop generator | `.loopgen.ron` | Procedural looping sounds for patch layers. | [Audio](user-guide/audio.md) |
| Terrain | RON | Heightfield, layers, scatter rules. | [Terrain](user-guide/terrain-vfx.md) |
| Terrain holes | `<map>.holes.ron` | Tunnel mouths cut through the terrain: a versioned `HolesMask` (at most 64 polygon, rect, ellipse or raster shapes; v2 adds named holes that open and close at runtime, ADR-1595). | [Tunnels](agents/tunnels.md), [Terrain runtime](agents/terrain-runtime.md) |
| VFX | `.vfx.ron` | GPU particle systems. | [VFX and decals](systems/vfx.md) |
| Decal prefab | `.decal.ron` | Projected decal (albedo, normal, roughness, emissive, mask). | [VFX and decals](systems/vfx.md) |
| Tilemap | `.tilemap.ron` (v2; also `.tmx`, `.tmj` via the Tiled importer) | Orthogonal, isometric, staggered and hexagonal maps; tilesets, tile layers (GIDs with flips), collision, animated tiles, objects. | [2D](user-guide/2d.md) |
| Sprite atlas | `.atlas.ron` | Images / grid sheets packed at cook time, with pivots and 9-slice borders. | [2D](user-guide/2d.md) |
| Save | binary (FSAVE) | World snapshot with header + CRC-32. | [Gameplay](user-guide/gameplay.md) |
| Pak | `.fpak` | Cooked-content archive. | [Packaging](user-guide/packaging.md) |
| glTF | `.gltf` / `.glb` | Neutral import format (cooked to the above). | [Materials](user-guide/materials.md) |
| glTF material detail layer | `REGIA_materials_detail` extension or `extras.regia_detail` on a glTF material | Sets `HardSurfaceParams::detail` from the glTF: normal, albedo, roughness and mask textures, UV scale, strengths and distance fade; `docs/formats/gltf-extensions.md`, no stored format changes (ADR-2000). | [Materials](user-guide/materials.md) |
| GPU-ready mesh | pak entry, magic `FGPM` (type `regia_asset::GpuMesh`), layout v2 (v1 still reads; `gpu-mesh`, ADR-2788) | Opt-in desktop pak mesh entry: the renderer's vertices with tangents, `u32` indices and the submesh ranges with their material slots (`REGIA_PAK_GPU_MESHES=1`, `pak_migrate`). | [Assets (agents)](agents/assets.md) |
| glTF punctual lights | `KHR_lights_punctual` on import: `GltfExtensionTable::lights`, `node_lights`; `GltfSpawnOptions::lights`, `editor.spawn_gltf_hierarchy { lights }` | Reads each light with the extension's defaults and spawns it on its node as `PointLight`, `SpotLight` or `DirectionalLight`. Not cooked (ADR-3016). | [glTF extensions on import](agents/gltf-extensions.md) |
| GPU-ready mesh | pak entry, magic `FGPM` (type `regia_asset::GpuMesh`), layout v1 | Opt-in desktop pak mesh entry: the renderer's vertices with tangents and `u32` indices (`REGIA_PAK_GPU_MESHES=1`, `pak_migrate`). | [Assets (agents)](agents/assets.md) |
| GI bake description | `.bake.ron` | Terrain, static meshes, interiors, lights and probe layout of a `regia bake-gi` job (v1). | [Baking GI from meshes](agents/baked-gi-bake.md) |
| Baked GI volume | `.fgiv` (v3; v1 and v2 load) | Probe grid, detail and interior bricks of a baked light volume; cooked as an asset. | [Baked GI](agents/baked-gi.md), [Baked GI from the level](agents/baked-gi-maps.md) |
| Cooked clip | pak entry, magic `FCLP` (v2; v1 loads unbound) | Animation clip payload with per-node morph tracks. | [Morph weights](agents/morph-weights.md) |
| GI validation record | `crates/regia_test_utils/gi_thresholds/<scene>.txt` (test data, not shipped) | Recorded GI error per scene and technique that `regia_pt`'s GI validation test holds (ADR-423). | [GI validation](agents/gi-validation.md) |
| GI bake description | `.bake.ron` | Terrain, static meshes, interiors, lights and probe layout of a `regia bake-gi` job (v2: HDRI sky and area emitters). | [Baking GI from meshes](agents/baked-gi-bake.md), [Bake light inputs](agents/baked-gi-light-inputs.md) |
| HDRI sky map | `.hdr` / `.pic` (RGBE), uncompressed `.exr` | Equirect sky of a GI bake (`sky_hdri`), read by `regia_pt::hdr` / `regia_pt::env_map`; sun extraction, `plan.lights` report. | [Bake light inputs](agents/baked-gi-light-inputs.md) |
| GI bake description | `.bake.ron` | Terrain, static meshes, interiors, lights, probe layout and bake quality controls of a `regia bake-gi` job (v2). | [Baking GI from meshes](agents/baked-gi-bake.md) |
| Lightmap | `.flmap` | Baked per-texel irradiance atlas for static meshes with each mesh's UV2 unwrap, the dominant light direction per texel, each entry's entity key and chart-seam figures, and optionally clusters over each unwrap (v4, ADR-2024, ADR-2107; v1 to v3 migrate). | [Lightmaps](agents/lightmaps.md) |
| Native crash record (Android) | `files/crash/pending.bin`, `<time>.crash.bin`, magic `FERCRASH`, layout v1 | One native crash written in-process by the Android signal handler: signal, address, thread, PC/LR/SP/FP, frame-pointer walk, build identity, executable maps lines (ADR-328). Read back on the next launch. | [Crash reports (agents)](agents/crash-reports.md) |
| Behavior tree | `.bt.ron` | A flat node arena plus a root index (`BehaviorTreeDef`); compile checks indices and cycles. | [AI (agents)](agents/ai.md) |
| Grass field | `.grass.ron` | Grass classes: density rules (terrain layers, slope and altitude bands, density map, noise, exclusions), blade shape, stem and shoot colours, range, shadows, sway (v1, ADR-1400). | [Terrain grass](agents/terrain-grass.md) |
| Scene render profile | `render_profile.txt` in a scene directory (plain text, not versioned) | One render preset name (`Cinematic`, `DesktopUltra`, …; `#` comments) a host reads through `regia_render::cinematic::choose_preset` after `--render-profile` and `REGIA_RENDER_PROFILE` (ADR-1403). | [Cinematic profile](agents/cinematic.md) |

| Lockstep desync bundle (`desync`) | `*.desync.ron` (`DesyncBundle`, `format_version` 1; diagnostic) | A diverged lockstep match: the last agreed snapshot, every frame after it as each seat's input bytes, the probe's subsystem rows and the live verdict; replayed by `regia net desync-replay` (spec 120 § 7.6, ADR-8455, `docs/formats/desync-ron.md`). | [Net desync (agents)](agents/net-desync.md) |
| Mesh layers source (`terrain-mesh-layers`) | `<map>.meshlayers.ron`, `<map>.passages.ron` (version 1) | A map's mesh layers and world geometry source: layers with their sources, fills and looks, the geometry settings, the ground mode and the section rule (spec 121 § 9.1, ADR-8112); a newer file is refused. | [Mesh-layer formats](agents/terrain-mesh-layers-formats.md) |
| Cooked mesh layers (`terrain-mesh-layers-cooked`) | `<map>.meshlayers` (`RGML`, version 2; v1 migrates, ADR-8816) | Derived: the header, the canonical world-geometry section (`content_hash`; fixed-width counts behind a hashed head since v2) and the presentation section (layer chunks and their LOD sub-assets, ADR-8398); a version mismatch cooks again. | [Mesh-layer formats](agents/terrain-mesh-layers-formats.md), [Mesh-layer seams](agents/terrain-mesh-layers.md) |
| Cooked terrain index v2 (`terrain-index`) and exact heights (`terrain-final-heights`) | `terrain/index` (postcard, `version` 2; v1 migrates) and `terrain/heights` (`RTFH`, v1) in a cooked map | The optional exact f32 heights (residuals over R16 or raw), holes (`.holes.ron` text at `terrain/holes`) and photoreal material blobs (`terrain/material/<kind>/<i>`) a host cooked (ADR-8024). | [Cooked photoreal terrain](agents/terrain-cooked-photoreal.md) |
| Project bus tree (`audio-buses`) | `config/audio.ron` (v1) | `BusLayout`: buses (volume, mute, effect chain with bypassed effects, post-fader sends), send buses and named snapshots (fader, mute and send levels with a blend time); v0 is the versionless shape v0.5.0 shipped (ADR-8105 (g), ADR-8354, `docs/formats/audio-buses-ron.md`). | [Audio mixer](agents/audio-mixer.md) |
| Project UI scale rule | `.uisettings.ron` (`uisettings` v2) | Optional `scale_mode`. v1 files load and `regia upgrade-project` rewrites only the version number. `editor.ui_scale_settings` takes `scale_mode` (ADR-8252). | [UI designer](agents/ui-designer.md) |
| Screen back, subtree disable and pivot | `.ui.ron` (`ui` v11, folded before the v0.6.0 tag) | File field `back` (`ignore` or `pop`); node fields `disabled_subtree` and `pivot`. Earlier v11 files read unchanged. `editor.ui_designer_edit` `set` takes those keys and `document.back` (ADR-8252). | [UI designer](agents/ui-designer.md) |
| Match replay v4 compatibility (read-only, ADR-8191) | `.do27replay` v4; existing `replay.load`, `replay.seek`, `replay.step` | Validates extra labels and skips bounded map/training records. Original v2/v3 readers and public struct shapes remain unchanged; undefined record boundaries are rejected. | [Replay](agents/replay.md) |
| Hover hull file (`hoverhull`) | `.hoverhull.ron` (v1) | Named hull tuning: optional fields default to the engine hull, optional limits and a flight-mode name; the host parses the text and the lockstep handshake compares `HoverParams::to_le_bytes` (ADR-8512, `docs/formats/hoverhull.md`). `detsim.hover_hull_check` checks a file. | [Hover step (lockstep)](agents/det-hover.md) |
| Logic graph reference | `regia_ai::logic::LogicGraphRef` component inside `.level.ron` / `.prefab.ron` (`logic-graph-ref` v1) | A logic graph authored on an entity: the project `.logic.ron` it runs, an enabled switch and starting values for graph locals; `AiPlugin` compiles it when added or changed (P-165, ADR-8566, `docs/formats/logic-graph-ref.md`). | [Prefab logic](agents/prefab-logic.md) |
| Delivery contract (`delivery-contract`) | `.contract.ron` (`format_version` 1) | One asset class's delivery settings: unit scale and its identity tolerance, up and forward axes, the ground origin, and the LOD chain with its triangle budgets (ADR-8401). Version 1 is the first shape; a newer file is refused (`contract_version_newer`). `assets.check_contract` judges a measured asset against it. | [Delivery contract](agents/delivery-contract.md) |
| Delivery contract (`delivery-contract`) | `.contract.ron` (`format_version` 1) | Per-class unit scale, axes, ground origin, LOD chain and triangle budgets, plus the kit rules folded into v1 (joint influences, required nodes, sockets and clips, material and texture caps, footprint, socket clearance). Unknown fields are refused, including inside the kit rows; corpus `v1.ron` and `v1-kit.ron` (ADR-8401, ADR-8450, ADR-8553, ADR-8622, `docs/formats/contract-ron.md`). | [Delivery contract](agents/delivery-contract.md) |
| Bike file (`bike`) | `.bike.ron` (v1) | A named `BikeConfig`: every field optional and filled from `BikeConfig::default()`, an optional note; named fields only, unknown names refused, the version read before the body (ADR-8630, `docs/formats/bike-ron.md`). The Vehicle Tuning panel opens, saves and rides it. | [Vehicle tuning: trailers, aircraft and proving-ground tracks (agents)](agents/vehicle-tuning.md) |
| Rule set file (`rules-ron`) | `.rules.ron` (v1) | A match mode as data: skeleton, `extends` (at most 4 ancestors), teams, session overrides field by field, win conditions and a typed option schema; the shipped `tdm`, `ffa`, `ctf`, `koth` and `dom` reproduce the Rust defaults bit for bit, and the resolved rules hash into the content handshake (ADR-8694, `docs/formats/rules-ron.md`). `regia rules check` and `rules.ruleset_validate` check a file. | [Game modes](user-guide/game-modes.md), [Match modes and match flow](agents/match-rules.md) |
| Deterministic utility catalogue (`ai-det-utility`) | `.detutility.ron` (`format_version` 1) | A lockstep AI utility catalogue: named inputs and up to 64 options in tie order, scored by integer math so every peer picks the same option. A newer version is refused (`det_utility_newer_version`) before any other field is read; the cook checks it the same way (ADR-8609, `docs/formats/ai-det-utility.md`). | [Deterministic AI core](agents/det-ai-core.md) |
| Release chunks (`release-chunks`) | `release-chunks.json` (`format_version` 1) | The chunk list `regia engine chunk cut` and `chunk pack` write: platform, tag, product version, source commit, and per chunk its group, bucket count, archive name and SHA-256, with a TSV sibling and a SHA-256 sidecar (ADR-8404, `docs/formats/release-chunks.md`). | [Release chunks](agents/release-chunks.md) |
| Source-lint policy (`source-lint`) | `config/source_lint.ron` (`format_version` 1) | The project's source-lint policy: default geometry and material thresholds, named profiles and per-glob asset overrides, read by the asset pipeline's source lint and the editor's lint jobs (ADR-8248, `docs/formats/source-lint-ron.md`). | [Source lint policy and jobs](agents/content-lint.md) |
| Terrain raster descriptor (`terrain-raster-descriptor` v1) | `heightfield.raster.json` (`{"raster_descriptor": 1, ...}`) | How a count raster is laid out when it is not schema-2's default: per-axis spacing, north-first rows or east-first columns, center or edge registration, origin, and no-data counts or a valid mask (ADR-8542; `docs/formats/terrain-raster-descriptor.schema.json`). | [Terrain source import limits](user-guide/terrain-sources.md) |
| Terrain source tiles (`terrain-source-tiles` v1) | `heightfield.tiles.json` (`{"terrain_source_tiles": 1, ...}`) | A large heightfield as several source files: the shared grid, units and each tile's placement; shared border samples must agree (ADR-8595; `docs/formats/terrain-source-tiles.schema.json`). | [Terrain source import limits](user-guide/terrain-sources.md) |
| Client capture | `.netcapture` (`format_version` 1) | What one client received and did, in its own milliseconds: magic `RNETCAPT`, a checksummed header with a label and the ring's counters, then checksummed records (session, receive, flush, accept, deny, decrypted packet, goodbye, ended, input, frame digest) and an end record; whole sessions only (ADR-8221, `docs/formats/netcapture.md`). | [Networking](user-guide/networking.md) |
| Lockstep match replay (`lsreplay`) | `*.lsreplay` (binary, `RGLSRPLY`, version 1) | A whole lockstep match: Fulls of the game's state, every agreed frame as each seat's input bytes, checkpoint hashes, peer commands and an abort record; audited bit for bit by `regia net replay-audit` (ADR-8513, `docs/formats/lsreplay.md`). | [Net lockstep replay (agents)](agents/net-lsreplay.md) |
| Release manifest signature (`release-signature` v1) | `manifest-<platform>.json.sig` (`{"format": 1, ...}`) | The detached Ed25519 signature `regia release sign` writes and `regia release verify` checks: algorithm, key id, public key, date, manifest SHA-256 and signature; unknown fields refused; fuzzed by `crates/regia_release_chunks/tests/fuzz.rs`, which the fuzz-target registry's `release-signature` row names (ADR-8687, registered by ADR-8846, `docs/formats/release-signature.md`). | [Release sign and upload](agents/release-sign.md) |
| Lobby hub config (`hub-toml` v1) | `hub.toml` (`format_version` 1, the first version, nothing migrates) | The `regia-lobby-hub` process's settings: bind address and port, key path, session and lobby caps, per-address and per-identity rate limits, status output; read by `regia_net::lobby::hub::HubFile::from_toml`, a named bad field is refused; every `regia package --server` writes the commented default beside the binary; `regia upgrade-project` lists it (ADR-8648, ADR-8891, `docs/formats/hub-toml.md`). | [Lobby hub process (agents)](agents/net-lobby-hub-binary.md) |
| Finished-match record (`match-result`) | `<root>/<utc-date>/<match_id>.json` (JSON, `version` 1) | One finished match: match id, ruleset id and hash, map, start and end step and tick, end reason, winner or draw, team rows, player rows (ids only, no names), the end-of-match ledger and the replay file name. Written atomically, rotated by age and count; a newer version is refused (`docs/formats/match-result.md`). | [Match results](agents/match-results.md), [Game modes](user-guide/game-modes.md#match-history-and-stats) |
| Lobby hub config (`hub-toml` v1) | `hub.toml` (`format_version` 1) | The `regia-lobby-hub` process's listen port, key path, caps and per-address and per-identity rate limits; registered by ADR-8648 (`docs/formats/hub-toml.md`); `regia package --server` stages a default one. | [Net lobby hub binary (agents)](agents/net-lobby-hub-binary.md) |
| Cooked mesh layers (`terrain-mesh-layers-cooked`) | `<map>.meshlayers` (`RGML`, version 1) | Derived: the header, the canonical world-geometry section (`content_hash`) and the presentation section (layer chunks and their LOD sub-assets, ADR-8398); a version mismatch cooks again. | [Mesh-layer formats](agents/terrain-mesh-layers-formats.md), [Mesh-layer seams](agents/terrain-mesh-layers.md) |
| `Regia.toml` `[game]` | `pause`, `pause_key`, `pause_gamepad`, `pause_screen` (optional keys, pause off by default, no version) | The game pause key: on or off, the key and the gamepad button of `TogglePause`, and the Paused screen (`default`, `none` or a `.ui.ron` path) (ADR-10104, `docs/formats/regia-toml-game.md`). | [Pausing a game](user-guide/pausing.md) |

## 5. Host extension methods → agent guide

Methods a crate registers on the world's `AgentExtension` (the editor, the Steam plugin, the cloth
methods) instead of the runtime schema table. `cargo xtask book-coverage` (and `book-check`) finds them
in the source and requires a row here naming the registering crate, a page that names the method and
a test that calls it; each registering crate also has a test that checks its real registrations
against this table (spec 96, [Book coverage](agents/book-coverage.md)).

Volume compares use `--check-volume <volume>`; `--check` takes no volume argument. | [Distribution and upgrade](agents/distribution-upgrade.md#template-acceptance-and-preservation) |

No new protocol method. | [UI backdrop blur](agents/ui-backdrop-blur.md#render-targets) |

| `ui.key` Ctrl+Left / Ctrl+Right and Home / End in right-to-left and mixed text; `CaretMap::visual_word_step`, `CaretLine::rtl` (ADR-9340) | Visual word moves (the next word edge on screen) and Home / End drawn at the line's visual edges by the paragraph's base level (UAX #9 P2/P3; an Arabic paragraph that opens with a number starts at its right edge): `regia_ui` `tests/text_input.rs` `ctrl_right_in_arabic_lands_on_the_next_visual_word_boundary`, `ctrl_right_steps_through_a_mixed_line_in_screen_order`, `end_lands_on_the_visual_end_of_a_right_to_left_line`, `home_in_a_right_to_left_paragraph_that_opens_with_a_number_goes_to_the_right_edge`; `ui.text_state` `visual_caret` reads the drawn edge. | [ui-text-input](agents/ui-text-input.md) |

| Existing surface | Coverage | Guide |

| `cargo xtask doc-examples [--update [--lower <why>]]` (repository tool) | Count the compiled and `ignore` doc examples of the stable crates, crate-level and item-level, against the floors in `docs/ci/doc-examples.toml`; a crate below its floor, over its ignore ceiling, or without a crate-level compiled example (and no waiver) fails; `--update` records a raise, `--lower` a lowering with its reason. | [Merge gate](user-guide/merge-gate.md) |

[road clear/regenerate recipe](agents/procgen.md#road-clearregenerate-regression-recipe) for the
three-cycle restoration/content checks and separate fresh-app bake reload. No method is added.

| Command | What it does | Page |
|---|---|---|
| `regia release verify <dir>` | Check a release directory against its manifests. Shallow checks sizes and SHA-256. `--deep` also decompresses every chunk and checks members. Exit 0 when clean, 1 when a check fails (ADR-8557). | [Release verify, diff, and upload plan](agents/release-verify-diff.md) |
| `regia release diff <old> <new>` | Report chunks added, removed and changed, a file that moved between chunks once, and the bytes to download per platform. Exit 0 after it prints, including when the releases differ (ADR-8557). | [Release verify, diff, and upload plan](agents/release-verify-diff.md) |
| `regia release upload-plan <dir>` | Print an ordered JSON upload plan: chunks first, then other payload, then manifests. The plan is retry-safe and does not contact a host (ADR-8557). | [Release verify, diff, and upload plan](agents/release-verify-diff.md) |
| `regia release sign <dir> --key <path> --date YYYY-MM-DD` | Write a detached Ed25519 `.sig` next to each release manifest. The signed payload is the file name, the manifest SHA-256 and the date. A key inside the project is refused (ADR-8687). | [Release sign and upload](agents/release-sign.md) |
| `regia release upload <dir> --backend fs:<dir>` | Copy the upload plan into a filesystem directory, chunks then payload then manifests, and write `PUBLISHED`. No network (ADR-8687). | [Release sign and upload](agents/release-sign.md) |
| `regia release upload <dir> --backend cli:<config.toml> [--var KEY=VALUE] [--dry-run]` | Upload the plan through a hosting CLI run as a child process with its arguments from an `upload_cli = 1` config: credentials only through the environment variables it names, redacted from every line; a dry run prints the command lines and starts nothing (ADR-8846). | [Release sign and upload](agents/release-sign.md) |

A preflight step. | [Onboarding: setting Regia up](agents/onboarding.md#checks-of-these-files) |
